title: What stangent-file-finder returns (Phase 3, D101)
description: Up to 10 files a ticket's work most likely changes, found by searching the repo, most likely first; each with words quoted from the ticket and a line quoted from the file. Up to 3 parts outside the code (D83). Code checks every file exists in the repo, every ticket quote is in the ticket and every line is in its file.

path.description: The file's path relative to the repo root, with forward slashes.

quote.description: Words from the ticket, exactly as written there (at least 4 words, or a whole line), that this file explains.

line.description: Code from the file, copied exactly (at least 12 characters and two words; one line, or a few joined by spaces), that connects it to the ticket.

why.description: One sentence: how this file is involved.

outside.description: Parts of the ticket whose cause lives outside the code (D83): the server, network, deployment, live data or a third party. Never a screen, an API or the app's own behaviour.

quote.description: Words from the ticket, exactly as written there (at least 4 words, or a whole line), that say so.
